dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged light-intensity perimeters forming multiple closed 'O' and open 'C' shaped structures. The perimeter edges exhibit high-contrast transitions from dark exterior pixels to thin, wavy, high-intensity borders around darker interior cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate spatial density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily distributed in the spaces between the larger macro-annuli in the mid-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest and most central macro-annuli form a distinct scalene triangle. A secondary grouping of high-intensity blobs near the posterior region aligns in a slightly curved linear formation.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex, labyrinthine network of interconnected and nested ring structures across the central lateral field.
